caseNameFull: Ethicon, Inc. v. Eisenmenger, an Incapacitated Person, by Eisenmenger, Her Guardian and Conservator

opinions.text:
Sup. Ct. Mont. Motion of American Cyanamid Co. et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Certiorari denied.

Justice Breyer took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and this petition.
